rationale_evidence.anchor: knowledge-lint.php is a 343-line 'PHPStan for knowledge' that is hard-scoped to docs/knowledge/ ... and never sees docs/knowledgeos/. That single scope gap is why the entire Track 2 corpus had zero mechanical coverage.

rationale_evidence.anchor: The durability migration chain (AMD3→AMD6) is literally the test corpus the assurance checker is being built to back-test against, and the checker's job list is literally the migration's own mandated pre-delivery verification.
rationale_evidence.statement: Finds that the two seemingly separate work items (cost-optimization/deterministic-assurance, and the durability migration) already share the same evidence base and back-test corpus, so integration is a sequencing/authority problem rather than a new architecture problem; the checker must remain warn-only through Phase 1 to avoid itself becoming a governance object requiring authority.
